Royal Jelly and Its Components Promote Healthy Aging and Longevity: From Animal Models to Humans
@article{Kunugi2019RoyalJA, title={Royal Jelly and Its Components Promote Healthy Aging and Longevity: From Animal Models to Humans}, author={Hiroshi Kunugi and Amira S. Mohammed Ali}, journal={International Journal of Molecular Sciences}, year={2019}, volume={20}, url={https://api.semanticscholar.org/CorpusID:202747364} }
